levels.title: LEVEL 00 — Computer & Digital Fundamentals
levels.subtitle: Arsitektur Komputer, Biner, CPU, Memori & Sistem Operasi
levels.description: Fondasi komputasi dari level gerbang logika hingga kernel OS, virtual memory, dan CLI untuk pemula.

modules.title: Hardware, CPU & Komponen Komputasi
modules.description: Cara kerja CPU, Register, Cache, Siklus Fetch-Decode-Execute, dan Hierarki Memori.

modules.title: Sistem Bilangan & Representasi Data Digital
modules.description: Biner, Hexadesimal, Two's Complement, Floating Point IEEE 754, dan Karakter Encoding (ASCII, UTF-8).

modules.title: Sistem Operasi, Kernel & Command Line Interface
modules.description: Kernel vs User Mode, System Calls, Process & Thread, File System, PowerShell & Bash.

levels.title: LEVEL 01 — Programming Logic & Problem Solving
levels.subtitle: Logika Pemrograman, Algoritma, Dekomposisi Masalah & Matematika Komputasi
levels.description: Membangun cara berpikir algoritmik dari nol sebelum menulis kode konkret dalam C#.

modules.title: Konsep Dasar Pemrograman & Eksekusi Kode
modules.description: Source code, Mesin penerjemah, Kompilasi vs Interpretasi, dan Runtime.

modules.title: Algoritma & Alur Kontrol Logika
modules.description: Sequence, Selection (Branching), Iteration (Looping), dan Rekursi.

levels.title: LEVEL 02 — C# Programming Fundamentals
levels.subtitle: Sintaks C#, Tipe Data, Value vs Reference, Kontrol Alur, Method & Koleksi
levels.description: Pengenalan lengkap ekosistem modern .NET dan C#, dari console app pertama hingga exception handling dan manipulasi file.

modules.title: Ekosistem .NET & Anatomi Program C#
modules.description: Sejarah .NET, CLR, Roslyn Compiler, .csproj, dotnet CLI, dan Program.cs.

modules.title: Sistem Tipe C#, Memori & Konversi
modules.description: Value Types, Reference Types, Stack vs Heap, Boxing/Unboxing, dan Nullable Types.

modules.title: Struktur Kontrol, Methods & Koleksi Data
modules.description: Kondisional, Pattern Matching, Perulangan, Method Parameters (ref, out, in), Arrays, List & Dictionary.

levels.title: LEVEL 03 — Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
levels.subtitle: Enkapsulasi, Abstraksi, Pewarisan, Polimorfisme, Struct, Record, Generics & Events
levels.description: Memahami paradigma berorientasi objek dalam C# dengan kedalaman arsitektur enterprise.

modules.title: Pilar Utama OOP & Anatomi Kelas
modules.description: Class, Object, Constructor, Properties, Enkapsulasi, dan Access Modifiers.

modules.title: Polimorfisme, Interface & Tipe Modern (Record & Struct)
modules.description: Virtual, Override, Abstract Class, Interface, Record Immutability, dan Struct.

modules.title: Generics, Delegates & Events
modules.description: Generics, Type Constraints, Func, Action, Events, dan Pencegahan Memory Leak.

levels.title: LEVEL 04 — Intermediate & Advanced C#
levels.subtitle: LINQ, Deferred Execution, Reflection, Source Generators, Span<T> & Memory<T>
levels.description: Teknik tingkat lanjut C# untuk manipulasi data efisien, metaprogramming, dan high-performance memory semantics.

modules.title: LINQ & Internal Iterasi
modules.description: Query vs Method Syntax, Deferred vs Immediate Execution, IEnumerable vs IQueryable, dan Yield Return.

modules.title: High-Performance Memory Semantics: Span<T> & Ref Struct
modules.description: Span<T>, ReadOnlySpan<T>, Memory<T>, stackalloc, dan zero-allocation parsing.

modules.title: Metaprogramming & Serialisasi Modern
modules.description: Reflection, Custom Attributes, Roslyn Source Generators, dan System.Text.Json Custom Converters.

levels.title: LEVEL 05 — Data Structures & Algorithms
levels.subtitle: Kompleksitas Asimptotik Big O, Hash Table, Pohon B-Tree/AVL, Graph & Dynamic Programming
levels.description: Struktur data dan algoritma fundamental yang diimplementasikan secara konkret dalam C# berorientasi performa enterprise.

modules.title: Analisis Algoritma & Kompleksitas Asimptotik
modules.description: Big O, Big Omega, Big Theta, Analisis Amortized, Best/Average/Worst Case.

modules.title: Struktur Data Linear & Hash-Based
modules.description: Dynamic Arrays, Linked List, Stack, Queue, Circular Queue, dan Hash Table Internals.

modules.title: Trees, B-Trees & Graph Algorithms
modules.description: Binary Search Tree, AVL, Red-Black, B-Tree (Index DB), Graph Traversal, dan Dijkstra.

levels.title: LEVEL 06 — Computer Architecture & Operating Systems
levels.subtitle: Cache Coherency, Context Switching, Paging, Inter-Process Communication & Thread Lifecycle
levels.description: Pemahaman mendalam mengenai interaksi perangkat lunak backend enterprise dengan OS dan hardware CPU modern.

modules.title: Mikroarsitektur CPU & Cache Locality
modules.description: Pipeline, Branch Prediction, Cache Lines, Spatial/Temporal Locality, dan False Sharing.

modules.title: Proses, Thread, Context Switch & Sinkronisasi
modules.description: Process Lifecycle, Thread Scheduling, Context Switching Cost, Critical Sections, dan Deadlocks.

levels.title: LEVEL 07 — Networking & Internet Engineering
levels.subtitle: OSI, TCP/IP, Three-Way Handshake, HTTP/1.1-2-3, TLS 1.3, Reverse Proxy & Load Balancer
levels.description: Arsitektur jaringan backend dari paket Ethernet fisik hingga Layer 7 HTTP/3, WebSockets, dan TLS Handshake.

modules.title: Fondasi Jaringan Komputer & Model TCP/IP
modules.description: OSI 7 Layers, IP Routing, Subnetting CIDR, TCP vs UDP, dan Socket.

modules.title: Protokol Aplikasi Web & Keamanan Transport
modules.description: HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 (Multiplexing), HTTP/3 (QUIC), TLS 1.3 Handshake, Certificates, PKI.

levels.title: LEVEL 08 — .NET Runtime & Internal Engineering
levels.subtitle: CoreCLR, JIT Compilation, Tiered PGO, Garbage Collector Gen 0/1/2/LOH & Profiling
levels.description: Bedah internal Common Language Runtime, pipeline kompilasi IL ke machine code, memori heap managed, dan garbage collection.

modules.title: Arsitektur CoreCLR & Pipeline Kompilasi JIT
modules.description: Intermediate Language (IL), JIT Compilation, Tiered Compilation, Dynamic PGO, dan Native AOT.

modules.title: Managed Memory & Garbage Collector Deep Dive
modules.description: Generational GC (Gen 0, 1, 2), Large Object Heap (LOH), Pinned Object Heap (POH), Workstation vs Server GC.

levels.title: LEVEL 09 — Database Engineering
levels.subtitle: Relasional vs NoSQL, Index B-Tree, ACID, MVCC, Query Execution Plan & Sharding
levels.description: Desain basis data enterprise berskala tinggi, indexing mendalam, transaksi ACID, isolasi MVCC, dan query tuning.

modules.title: Database Modeling & Relational Schema Design
modules.description: Relational Modeling, Normalisasi 1NF-BCNF, Denormalisasi Strategis, Keys & Constraints.

modules.title: Database Engine Architecture, Indexing & Storage Pages
modules.description: Pages & Extents, Buffer Pool, Clustered vs Non-Clustered Indexes, Covering Index, B-Tree Traversal.

modules.title: Transaksi, Tingkat Isolasi ACID, Lock & MVCC
modules.description: Read Uncommitted, Read Committed, Repeatable Read, Serializable, Snapshot Isolation, MVCC, dan Deadlock.

levels.title: LEVEL 10 — C# Database Integration
levels.subtitle: ADO.NET, Dapper High-Performance Micro-ORM, EF Core 8 & Repository Pattern
levels.description: Integrasi data tingkat enterprise di C#: Dari ADO.NET murni, Dapper ultra-fast, hingga Entity Framework Core 8.

modules.title: Akses Data Tingkat Rendah & Dapper Micro-ORM
modules.description: ADO.NET, Parameterized Queries (Anti-SQLi), Dapper Query/Execute, dan Multi-Mapping.

modules.title: Entity Framework Core 8 Architecture & Optimasi
modules.description: DbContext, Change Tracker, AsNoTracking, Fluent API, Migrations, Eager/Lazy/Explicit Loading.

levels.title: LEVEL 11 — ASP.NET Core & Backend API Engineering
levels.subtitle: Kestrel, Request Pipeline, Middleware, Minimal APIs, Dependency Injection & REST
levels.description: Membangun REST API modern, scalable, dan secure menggunakan ASP.NET Core 8 Kestrel dan Generic Host.

modules.title: Arsitektur ASP.NET Core & Middleware Pipeline
modules.description: Kestrel Web Server, HttpContext, Middleware Execution Chain, dan Custom Middleware.

modules.title: Dependency Injection Container & Konfigurasi Enterprise
modules.description: Service Lifetimes (Transient, Scoped, Singleton), Captive Dependencies, Circular References, Options Pattern.

levels.title: LEVEL 12 — Concurrency, Threading & Parallel Programming
levels.subtitle: Task, Async/Await State Machine, SemaphoreSlim, Channels & Lock-Free Interlocked
levels.description: Pemrograman konkuren dan asinkronus bebas deadlock, high-throughput I/O processing, dan sinkronisasi thread di .NET.

modules.title: Model Asinkronus & State Machine C#
modules.description: Task-Based Asynchronous Pattern (TAP), State Machine Generation, Task vs ValueTask, CancellationToken.

modules.title: Sinkronisasi Thread, Lock & High-Throughput Channels
modules.description: Monitor (lock), SemaphoreSlim, ReaderWriterLockSlim, Interlocked CAS, System.Threading.Channels.

levels.title: LEVEL 13 — Software Design Principles & Architecture
levels.subtitle: SOLID, Clean Architecture, Vertical Slice, Tactical Domain-Driven Design (DDD) & ADR
levels.description: Prinsip rekayasa perangkat lunak enterprise, pemisahan dependensi, domain-driven design, dan arsitektur yang tahan uji masa depan.
keyTopics: Clean vs Onion vs Hexagonal Architecture

modules.title: Prinsip Desain SOLID & Pola Desain Enterprise
modules.description: Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov, Interface Segregation, Dependency Inversion, Strategy, Mediator.

modules.title: Arsitektur Aplikasi Bersih & Domain-Driven Design
modules.description: Clean Architecture, Vertical Slice Architecture, Strategic & Tactical DDD (Aggregates, Value Objects, Domain Events).

levels.title: LEVEL 14 — Distributed Systems & Microservices
levels.subtitle: CAP Theorem, Event-Driven Architecture, Kafka/RabbitMQ, Saga Pattern & Outbox
levels.description: Prinsip sistem terdistribusi, komunikasi pesan asinkronus, transaksi kompensasi Saga, dan ketahanan terhadap kegagalan parsial.

modules.title: Fondasi Sistem Terdistribusi & Konsistensi Data
modules.description: Network Partitions, Partial Failure, CAP Theorem, Eventual Consistency, Vector Clocks, Consensus Raft.

modules.title: Event-Driven Architecture & Message Brokers
modules.description: RabbitMQ Exchanges/Queues, Apache Kafka Partitions/Consumer Groups, Message Ordering, Dead Letter Queues.

modules.title: Pola Transaksi Terdistribusi & Ketahanan Sistem
modules.description: Transactional Outbox Pattern, Saga Pattern (Orchestration vs Choreography), Polly Circuit Breaker, Exponential Backoff.

levels.title: LEVEL 15 — Security Engineering
levels.subtitle: Zero Trust, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, JWT Hardening, OWASP Top 10 & Kriptografi Modern
levels.description: Keamanan backend enterprise: Otentikasi, otorisasi berbasis klaim, enkripsi data at rest & transit, dan mitigasi kerentanan tingkat sistem.

modules.title: Identitas, Otentikasi & Otorisasi Modern
modules.description: Password Hashing (Argon2id, BCrypt), JWT Architecture, Refresh Token Rotation, Policy-Based Authorization.

modules.title: Pertahanan OWASP Top 10 & Kriptografi Backend
modules.description: SQL Injection, SSRF, IDOR, Mass Assignment, AES Enkripsi Simetris, RSA Asimetris, Audit Trail.

levels.title: LEVEL 16 — Testing, Quality Engineering & DevOps
levels.subtitle: Piramida Tes, xUnit, WebApplicationFactory, Docker Multi-Stage, CI/CD & Kubernetes
levels.description: Otomasi kualitas perangkat lunak dari unit test, integration test database kontainer, hingga pipeline CI/CD dan deployment Kubernetes.

modules.title: Strategi Pengujian Backend & Otomasi xUnit
modules.description: Unit Test vs Integration Test, xUnit Theories/Facts, WebApplicationFactory, Mocking vs Faking.

modules.title: Konteinerisasi Docker, CI/CD & Kubernetes
modules.description: Dockerfile Multi-stage aman, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Kubernetes Pods, Deployments, Readiness/Liveness Probes.

levels.title: LEVEL 17 — Production, Performance & Reliability Engineering (SRE)
levels.subtitle: Observability, OpenTelemetry, BenchmarkDotNet, SLI/SLO, Postmortem & GC Tuning
levels.description: Mengoperasikan backend di produksi dengan keandalan 99.99%: Observability terdistribusi, profiling performa mikrodetik, dan SRE incident response.

modules.title: Observability Terdistribusi & Monitoring
modules.description: Structured Logging, Distributed Tracing dengan OpenTelemetry, Correlation ID propagation, Prometheus & Grafana.

modules.title: Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) & Incident Management
modules.description: SLI, SLO, SLA, Error Budget, Blameless Postmortem, On-Call Playbooks, Graceful Degradation.

modules.title: Investigasi & Optimasi Performa Produksi
modules.description: BenchmarkDotNet, dotnet-dump, dotnet-trace, Analisis High CPU & Memory Leak di Produksi.

levels.title: LEVEL 18 — Enterprise Architecture & Principal Engineering
levels.subtitle: Double-Entry Ledger, Financial Transactions, Legacy Modernization & Kepemimpinan Teknik
levels.description: Tingkat tertinggi rekayasa backend: Arsitektur perbankan dan transaksi finansial, buku besar double-entry, tata kelola arsitektur, dan kepemimpinan engineering organisasi.

modules.title: Arsitektur Transaksi Finansial & Buku Besar Double-Entry
modules.description: Prinsip Akuntansi Finansial, Double-Entry Ledger, Debit/Kredit Invariants, Settlement, Idempotency, dan Reversal.

modules.title: Arsitektur Enterprise Skala Global & Modernisasi Sistem
modules.description: Multi-Tenant Isolation, Multi-Region Active-Active, Zero-Downtime Database Migration, Strangler Fig Pattern.

modules.title: Kepemimpinan Teknik & Peran Principal Engineer
modules.description: Architecture Governance, Architecture Decision Records (ADR), Mentoring, Technical Vision, dan Risk Management.
